## Voo4Skeleton Workspace Rules

Scope: apply these rules to changes made in this repository.

### Language
- Code comments and inline technical explanations must be written in English.
- Repository documentation, README files, issue templates, and user-facing project documentation must be written in French.

### Documentation intent
- Keep documentation concise and practical.
- Prefer documenting the current recommended workflow in the main README.

### Template repository specifics
- Remember that this repository is a template used to initialize new projects.
- Keep it a pure template: no GitHub workflow, no build chain. Everything in it is inherited by every new project.
- Docker images are built in the fwk-docker-images repository, which holds its own copy of the minimal app.
